slides.title: Copy text without the mess
slides.text: Fonts, colors, links, hidden text, invisible characters and tracking junk stay behind.

slides.title: Alt+Shift+V copies it clean
slides.text: Or right-click → Copy clean. A small note tells you what was removed.

slides.title: Or make every Ctrl+C clean
slides.text: Pick the sites where you copy a lot. Normal copies there come out clean, nothing new to learn.

slides.title: Tidy line breaks, bullets and links
slides.text: Merge lines copied from PDFs and emails. Drop utm_source, fbclid and other tracking parameters.

slides.title: Your own cleanup rules
slides.text: Find and replace with plain text or regular expressions, checked live as you type.
